site.name: GameCodesHub
site.tagline: Working codes for popular Roblox games
site.description: Free promo codes for the most popular Roblox games — updated every few hours. Active codes, expiry dates and step-by-step redemption.
home.title: Roblox Promo Codes
home.subtitle: Pick a game, copy a code, redeem it in-game. The list is checked automatically every 8 hours.
game.musicRedeemText: Open the game, get into a vehicle and find the music box icon. Paste the ID there and press play — the track starts for everyone in the vehicle.
game.noCodes: There are no active codes for this game right now. Check back later — the list is refreshed automatically.
game.redeemText: Launch the game and look for a Codes or Redeem button — usually in the main menu, settings or shop. Enter the code exactly as shown and confirm. If a code is rejected, it has likely expired.
game.expiredNote: These codes no longer work, but we keep the list so you don't waste attempts.
about.title: About GameCodesHub
about.p1: GameCodesHub is an independent fan project that collects promo codes for popular Roblox games in one place. The list is refreshed automatically every 8 hours, so you see active codes without digging through forums and videos.
about.p2: We are not affiliated with, endorsed by or sponsored by Roblox Corporation or the developers of the games listed. All game names and trademarks belong to their respective owners.
about.p3: Codes are collected from public sources and checked for relevance against multiple sources. Descriptions and texts on this site are written by us.
